moves.name: Try This!
moves.description: Turns the field of play’s terrain into Psychic Terrain. Raises the user’s Defense, Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, and Speed by stat ranks. Replaces the user’s moves with different moves. Replaces some of the user’s passive skills with different passive skills.

moves.name: Attack!
moves.description: Raises the user’s Sp. Atk by stat ranks. Raises the user’s critical-hit rate by stat ranks. Change into Attack Forme until the end of battle.

moves.name: Faster!
moves.description: Reduces the user’s sync move countdown by. Raises the user’s Speed by stat ranks. Raises the user’s evasiveness by stat ranks. Change into Speed Forme until the end of battle.

moves.name: Defend!
moves.description: Raises the Attack and Sp. Atk of all allied sync pairs by stat ranks. Applies the to the user. Change into Defense Forme until the end of battle.

passives.name: Downside Up
passives.description: When the user’s stats would be lowered, raises the user’s stats by the same amount instead.

passives.name: Pinpoint Entry 1
passives.description: Raises the user’s accuracy by stat ranks when it enters a battle.

passives.name: Entry Freebie
passives.description: Applies the Free Move Next effect to the user when it enters a battle.

passives.name: Expanded Sync
passives.description: When the user’s sync move attacks an opponent, the target becomes all opposing sync pairs. The power of sync moves affected by this passive skill is not lowered even if there are multiple targets.

passives.name: Power Combo 2
passives.description: Has a chance ([Digit:2digits ]%) of increasing the user’s Physical Moves ↑ Next effect and Special Moves ↑ Next effect by [Digit:1digit Idx="1" ] [EN:Qty Ref="1" S="rank" P="ranks" ] when its move is successful.

passives.name: Afflicter’s Fervor 2
passives.description: Reduces the user’s sync move countdown by [Digit:1digit ] the first time its Pokémon uses a status move each battle.

passives.name: Catalytic Infliction
passives.description: Applies the [Name:ReferencedMessageTag ] to the allied field of play the first time the user’s Pokémon uses a status move each battle.

passives.name: Stat Share 9
passives.description: When a status move used by the user’s Pokémon raises its stats only, raises the same stats by the same amount for all allied sync pairs instead.

passives.name: Team Mind-Bracing Infliction+ 9
passives.description: Raises the [Name:ReferencedMessageTag ] of all allied sync pairs by [Digit:1digit Idx="1" ] stat [EN:Qty Ref="1" S="rank" P="ranks" ] when the user’s Pokémon uses a status move.

passives.name: Fuel Economy 1
passives.description: Decreases the amount of move gauge slots the user’s Pokémon needs to use moves by [Digit:1digit ].

passives.name: Aggravation 2
passives.description: Raises the chance of inflicting the flinching, confused, or trapped condition with the additional effects of moves.
